verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs broadly support pulling data via API for dashboards and analysis (klaviyo-docs-18) and confirm campaign creation/event endpoints (klaviyo-docs-7, klaviyo-docs-30) and SDKs for warehousing (klaviyo-docs-3, klaviyo-docs-23), and the MCP docs mention 'flow performance reports' (klaviyo-docs-33). However, there is no specific evidence of a dedicated campaign/flow metrics or reporting API endpoint, aggregation schema, or example of warehouse integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a campaign/flow performance metrics endpoint, sample metrics payload, and independent confirmation of warehouse/dashboard use.
